message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly options (and many of them have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate dietary requests):

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Sook’s Kitchen** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | 100% plant‑based menu; all dishes are naturally vegetarian/vegan. |
| **Thai Basil** | 2001 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑5678 | Offers a “Vegetarian” section on the menu; many curries and stir‑fries can be made vegetarian. |
| **Baan Thai** | 400 W 26th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑9012 | Has a separate vegetarian menu; can customize most dishes to be meat‑free. |
| **Tasty Thai** | 1500 W Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60657 | (312) 555‑3456 | Provides a vegetarian menu; many noodle dishes and curries can be prepared without meat. |
| **The Greenhouse** | 500 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60654 | (312) 555‑7890 | Primarily a vegetarian/vegan spot, but they serve Thai-inspired dishes like Pad Thai (made with tofu). |

All of these places are within easy reach of downtown Chicago and have positive reviews for their vegetarian offerings. If you’re looking for a specific dish or want to confirm availability, it’s a good idea to call ahead or check their websites for the latest menu updates.
